rule: Asset-license classification and website access policy are independent gates. PRIVATE_OFFLINE_ONLY may relax commercial-clearance blocking for the owner's local experiment, but it never authorizes scraping, authentication/paywall/DRM bypass, or prohibited bulk automation.

PUBLIC_API_AUTO.meaning: Provider documents a public API or stable public machine endpoint suitable for automated staging.

PUBLIC_DIRECT_RESOLVER.meaning: Official public item/pack pages expose direct downloads and no contrary automation restriction has been identified. Resolver remains rate-bounded and item-scoped.

MANUAL_CLEAR_LICENSE.meaning: Asset license is clear enough for use, but provider access is manual/item-based or bulk automation is restricted/undocumented.

AUTH_REQUIRED.meaning: Login/OAuth/account entitlement is required. Automation may use only an officially supported authenticated path after credentials are connected.

REFERENCE_ONLY.meaning: Discovery/reference source only; no automatic production ingest.

guardrails: No automated source where terms prohibit bots, scraping or bulk download.
Rate-limit public resolvers and prefer provider APIs.
Quaternius unresolved packs remain candidates; do not fabricate direct download URLs.
PRIVATE_OFFLINE_ONLY does not authorize provider-access bypass or redistribution.
A provider stage that resolves zero payload files must not be treated as successful staging for any downstream candidate gate.
Quaternius pack-page reachability is metadata/license evidence only until an official provider-supported direct payload URL or manual acquisition exists.
private_offline_rule: Unknown or non-commercially-cleared assets may be catalogued or locally integrated only when explicitly tagged PRIVATE_OFFLINE_ONLY and kept out of distributable/commercial exports. Access-method restrictions remain unchanged.
